api.clean_busy: This runner is running a job. Try again when it finishes.
api.clean_running: Another cleanup is running. Try again when it finishes.
system.confirm_clean_work:
Clean the work directory of {{name}}?

Checkouts and build output are deleted, so the next job starts from scratch and may take longer. The tool cache stays. Refused while a job runs.
system.confirm_clean_cache:
Delete Docker build cache older than 24 hours?

This covers the whole server. Nothing running is affected; the next builds may take longer.
system.confirm_clean_images:
Delete images no container uses and that are older than 7 days?

This covers the whole server, including other apps on it. Older images kept for a rollback in Coolify are deleted too and would have to be built again. Volumes and data are not touched.
system.volumes_note: Volumes are never cleaned from here: a volume looks unused while its service is stopped, and it may hold a database.
system.autoclean_hint: Empties the work directory when a runner has had no job for this long. The tool cache stays, and a running job is never touched.
event.work_auto_cleaned: Work directory cleaned automatically after {{detail}} idle days
system.diskguard_hint: Past this, untagged images and build cache older than 6 hours are removed for the whole server, and all build cache if that is not enough. Running containers, tagged images and volumes are not touched.
event.disk_guard: Disk at {{detail}}: untagged images and old build cache removed
event.disk_still_full: Disk still at {{detail}} after cleanup. Unused tagged images or other files need attention.
sessions.subtitle: Everything signed in to this Manager. A session stays signed in for 180 days after it was last used.

mcp.hint: Add this address to an MCP client such as Claude. It signs in with OAuth, and appears above as a session.
consent.title: Allow access?
consent.invalid: This sign-in request is not valid.
consent.read_hint: It can see runners, logs, history and resource use, and change nothing.
consent.write_hint: It can also add, start, stop and remove runners, which cancels running jobs.
